name: Icon
summary: A small symbol that supports text. Rules for size, stroke, labeling and consistency.

anatomy.purpose: Drawn on a 24px grid (layout grid) with a consistent 2px stroke.
A 44px hit area when the icon is a control.
Visible text, or aria-label when interactive.

variants.name: Decorative
variants.use: Next to text that already says the same.

whenToUse: Reinforcing text or labeling a familiar action.
whenNotToUse: Mixing outline and filled styles randomly.

keyboard: Not focusable unless inside a control.
accessibility.focus: Focus is on the control, not the glyph.
notes: Informative icons need alt or aria-label.
One style and stroke weight across the product.

code.html:
<svg width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0a0a0a" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
  <path d="M5 12l5 5L20 7"/>
</svg>
